title: Question Mark Texturepack
description: This pack turns the textures of oak log, pale oak log and dark oak log into 3 different types of question marks.... Useful for YouTube videos
body:
# Description
 Turns red stained glass, yellow stained glass, orange stained glass, red stained glass pane , yellow stained glass pane and orange stained glass pane into different Question Mark Blocks for fun builds, maps, and decoration...
 
Note :- If you wanted aa inventory slot to show a question mark, you can used glass pane varients, and if you wanted a block to show a question mark, you can use the stained glass varients


The pack is lightweight, simple, and doesn't change any gameplay. It only replaces textures, making it perfect for survival worlds, creative builds, minigames, and custom maps.

# Changes

red stained glass          → Question Mark Block Variant 1
yellow stained glass       → Question Mark Block Variant 2
orange stained glass       → Question Mark Block Variant 3
red stained glass pane     → Question Mark Inventory Slot Variant 1
yellow stained glass pane  → Question Mark Inventory Slot Variant 2
orange stained glass pane  → Question Mark Inventory Slot Variant 3

# Compatibility
 Works with Minecraft Java Edition
 Resource Pack only (no mods required)
 
I made this pack because I thought it would be fun to have question mark blocks available for builds without adding any new items or mods.
Also helps in youtube shorts..

If you find any issues or have suggestions for more block replacements, feel free to leave feedback!

Open for suggestions...
